DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_MysteryMask:
The mask it wears is not its face, they say.
It seems in front, but it's not there, no way.
From shadows deep, it watches night and day.
Glance away, and closer it will stray.

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_MysteryMask:
While in party, 
increases Party Pals' <Status_Keyword>EXP gained</> by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. (Does not stack)

Sometimes drops Feybreak materials when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
